notes.title: Customization & Mac Update Released!
notes.notes:
[IMG]https://i.imgur.com/HmQIFoO.jpg[/IMG]

[h1]We are proud to announce the release of the version 1.2 update![/h1]
This update is one of our biggest updates yet and there's lots to go through.


[h1]Character Customization & Items[/h1]
Bunny Hop League now has character customization! 
The game uses the Steam inventory service to randomly drop items as you play the game. You can then equip these items to your character to personalize it.
There are 5 different type of items. Head, Torso, Legs, Back and Wield. Each item has a rarity level assigned to it. There are 5 different rarity levels. Junk, Common, Uncommon, Rare and Legendary. The higher the level, the lower the chance of it dropping.
There are three ways to acquire items for your character.
[list]
[*]Play the game! Items drop randomly as you play the game. All items are droppable ingame, there are no items that can only be purchased.
[*]Buy them on the marketplace from other players.
[*]Buy them in the item store. There aren't a lot of items available in the item store, especially the higher level ones. For those who don't want to rely on random drops or buying on the marketplace, this is the place for you to acquire items.
[/list]

[h1]Mac Version[/h1]
Bunny Hop League is now available for those of you who own a Mac!
The game works just like it does on Windows and multiplayer is cross platform compatible, so you are able to join anyone online.

[h1]Performance[/h1]
We're happy to say that this update is a huge leap in performance across all systems. Most people can expect around 75-150% increase in fps. Lower end laptops should now handle the game a whole lot better than they did previously. In a test we did, we jumped from 18fps to 150fps using the same graphics settings.
There are also many new graphics options to allow you to customize the experience for your hardware.
We'd love to hear about what hardware you are running and what kind of fps you're getting on what settings!

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]New maps: Welkin Blue, Stone 1, Stone 2 and Ruins 2
[*]Respawn platforms are now removed. You can now stop on any platform
[*]Songs will no longer randomly skip
[*]14 new music tracks added
[*]Fixed spectator issues
[*]Increased margins around chat messages
[*]Fixed FOV not updating correctly at times
[*]Head now orients itself to where you're looking
[*]Totally revamped the head bob system. It's now called "Camera Animations" and gives you a much more immersive experience. The new system can however still be disabled if you prefer the static look
[*]Many sounds were totally remade
[*]Music popup now doesn't appear if you set the music volume to 0
[*]The audio have been remixed to have better levels
[*]Added a new first startup info box
[*]Stats now display in the menu
[*]Multiplayer movement should now be smoother
[*]Server player count has been removed as there's a bug with the engine that always thinks there's just 1 person on the server
[*]Under the hood system optimizations and improvements
[*]Your shadow should no longer be delayed
[*]Stability improvements
[*]Trimping now limited on Ancient >:)
[/list]


We hope you enjoy the new update as much as we have making it!

Best of Regards,
PolyDigital

notes.title: 1.2 Pre release info
notes.notes:
Hello!

[h1]Bad news[/h1]
We're sorry to say that we will need to postpone the 1.2 update until early next week due to personal reasons within the team that has gotten in the way of us releasing it this week and we are sorry for that.

[h1]Good news[/h1]
We can however give you some good news as well! We have spent a lot of time and effort on this update, one of the things have been optimizing the game to run better on all computers. We can proudly say that you should be able to expect a 50-100% increase in fps! Lower spec computers will be able to run the game a whole lot easier than previously.
For example:
[list]
[*]We tested the game on an old laptop with a i5 2.5ghz cpu and a extremely crappy Nvidia NVS 4200M gpu. The game used to run at around 15-18 fps at the lowest possible setting. Now it runs at around 150fps while looking slightly better than previously!
[*]On a dekstop computer featuring a Ryzen 1700x cpu and a 1080Ti gpu, the game used to run at around 200 fps. Now it runs at around 350-400.
[/list]
As you can imagine, that's quite a huge increase and we are very happy to say that the results have been very consistent on multiple computers. There's also a whole lot more graphics options available to fully configure the game to run as good as possible on your machine.

There's a lot more coming with the 1.2 update but this is one of the things we're really happy about!



We hope you are looking forward to this update as much as we are and we hope we didn't disappointyou by delaying the release for a few days.

Best of regards, PolyDigital

notes.title: 1.0 Transitioning out of early access
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11203908/3395a01f79f46b1409917ded06b8f96bb3e6dd3b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

On this day exactly a year ago, Bunny Hop League was first released on steam. We've come a long way since the very first version of the game and we thank all of you for participating in the early access and helping us shape the game to become what it is today.

Version 1.0 comes with a long list of changes.

[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
Online mupliplayer has made it's way into Bunny Hop League. Now you can challenge and compete against your friends to see who is the ultimate bunny hop guru!

[h1]Maps[/h1]
As usual, new maps have been added to the game. Check the level selection screen to see what's new! As before, we will continue to add more maps in the future!

[h1]Sliding and Ramping[/h1]
We're reintroducing the gamemode Sliding with the addition of a new mode called Ramping. You can find them at the top of the level selection screen.

[h1]Music[/h1]
The music library has also gone through an upgrade, and will continue to do so in the future! If you'd like your music to be featured in the game, please contact us at "contact@polydigital.se".

[h1]Achievements, Trading Cards and Stats[/h1]
There's an achievement linked to finishing every level in the game as well as a few other ones. 
We now keep track of a few stats as you're playing the game, we'll expand on these further on. 
You can now collect trading cards and craft yourself a new badge or why not a new profile background?

[h1]Bugs[/h1]
Many, many bugs have been fixed. We're sure there will be plenty more as with any game but they will be taken care of accordingly!

Many more things have changed since the last update and will continue to do so. Thank you again for supporting us this year, we hope to see as many of you guys as possible posting records, videos and what not. We'd love to see what you're up to!


Regards,

PolyDigital

notes.title: Biggest update so far! 0.4 is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11203908/6352bc3b9e6a8d4e6dec3351517c0372039c2ed8.jpg[/img]

[h1]Version 0.4 has been released![/h1]
The biggest update to Bunny Hop League so far!
This update have been in the works for a long time and it is finally available to you.

Something to note with this update is that records will be reset due to a new timer system being implemented.



[h1]Features[/h1]
Here are some of the biggest features of this update.
[list]
    [*]Completely redesigned UI
    [*]New timer system (Now with greater accuracy and less bugs)
    [*]New main menu
    [*]7 Brand new maps to jump across
    [*]Sci Fi 2 remastered and added once again
    [*]Tutorial level (to show you newcomers the art of bunny hopping)
    [*]Keybinding
    [*]Music (Will be expanded upon)
    [*]V-Sync support
    [*]Many bug fixes
    [*]As always, tweaks to underlying systems
    [*]Basic achievements (There will be more in the future!)
    [*]Total hard drive space required reduced considerably
    [*]Performance increase
[/list]


[h1]New maps[/h1]
List of all new map additions.
[list]
    [*]Tutorial
    [*]Fog
    [*]Fog 2
    [*]Construct
    [*]Fast
    [*]Splash
    [*]Limbo
[/list]


[h1]Thank you![/h1]
We hope that you'll enjoy this update as we continue to improve the game and to add plenty more content.
Interact with us in the community hub and help us make this game greater!
And don't forget to post your records!

Cheers
PolyDigital

notes.title: Big things are coming
notes.notes:
A lot of things have been happening to Bunny Hop League. We have been working hard on a massive update since version 0.3 was released.
A lot of things have been changed or added, more information will come when we release the next update but here are a few examples.


[h1]Version 0.4[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Completely redesigned UI
    [*]Music
    [*]Several new levels
    [*]Keybinding (Yes, finally)
    [*]And bug fixes of course!
[/list]

These are just a few of the many things featured in the upcoming 0.4 update!


[h1]When will it be available?[/h1]
Version 0.4 is estimated to be released within a week from this day!

We are very excited to see what everyone thinks about where the game is going.

Regards
The PolyDigital Team

notes.title: We're looking for testers!
notes.notes:
Hey people!

We're currently looking for skilled bunny hoppers to help us out with testing prerelease versions of the game!

This includes map testing, bug reporting and general feedback.

If you're interested, contact either "Measuring" or "117Caboose" on Steam and explain why you would like to be a tester and a bit about your previous Bunny Hop experience.


Regards,
PolyDigital

notes.title: Version 0.3 coming your way!
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow bhoppers!

Version 0.3 is just around the corner and you will be able to download it very soon!

[h1]Features![/h1]
[list]
    [*]New maps. Cobble and Generic 2!
    [*]Toggleable heabob
    [*]Toggleable motion blur
    [*]You are now able to jump by scrolling the mouse wheel!
    [*]Tweaks to movement system
    [*]Bug fixes
[/list]

[h1]Future updates will include some of the following[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Experimental local multiplayer
    [*]More sound effects
    [*]Music
    [*]More maps
    [*]Achievements
[/list]
Stay tuned for these upcoming updates!
Like us on [url=facebook.com/polydigital] Facebook	[/url] or follow us on [url=twitter.com/polydigital] Twitter [/url] to stay up to date!

Regards
The PolyDigital Team!

notes.title: Version 0.2 released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We're happy to announce that version 0.2 of Bunny Hop League was just released!

[h1]New website![/h1]
We also just published a website for BHL. It doesn't contain much currently but that will change some time in the future. For bug reports and feedback, please visit the website!

http://www.polydigital.se/bhl/


[h1]New features in 0.2[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Heavily tweaked movement system
    [*]Stopwatch to keep track of record times!
    [*]Toggle the new velocity meter
    [*]Toggle the new fps meter
    [*]Toggle the crosshair
    [*]Performance improvements
    [*]Additional resolution options
    [*]Remapped sensitivity slider
    [*]Static loading screen added
    [*]Game no longer goes dark at lower graphical settings
[/list]


Let us know what you think!
Thank you!

//Polydigital

notes.title: Small update and thank you!
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings everyone![/h1]

We'd like to start off with thanking everyone who purchased Bunny Hop League, we truly appreciate it! 
We value your feedback, it really helps us improve the game in a lot of ways. So keep telling us what you think about things!

Audio is currently being implemented and basic audio will most likely be available in the next update.

[h1]A new version of BHL is now available to you trough steam![/h1]
It's a small update with a few new features and tweaks. For details, read the list bellow.

[list]
    [*]Makeshift key binding
    [*]Sensitivity value (This value can not be compared to other bhop capable games since they are completely different engines)
    [*]Player acceleration when walking
    [*]Tweaks to air acceleration
    [*]Version information in menu
    [*]Fixed levels where you could go outside the map
[/list]


//The PolyDigital Team
